```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create a sample narwhals DataFrame
data = {
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [100, 200, 150],
    "feb": [120, 210, 160],
    "mar": [130, 220, 170]
}
native_df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df = nw.from_native(native_df)

# Reshape from wide to long format
result = df.unpivot(
    index="id",
    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales"
)

print(result.to_native())
```
